text:
Predicates:
InternationalStudent(x) ::: x is an international student in US.
HasF1(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
HasJ1(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
ApplyCPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for CPT.
ApplyOPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for OPT.
WantsToWork(x) ::: x wants to work in the US.
Premises:
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) → HasF1(x) ∨ HasJ1(x)) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x ((InternationalStudent(x) ∧ HasF1(x) ∧ WantsToWork(x)) → (ApplyCPT(x) ∨ ApplyOPT(x))) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT or OPT if the student wants to work in the US.
InternationalStudent(mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
WantsToWork(mike) → ApplyCPT(mike) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.
Conclusion:
HasF1(mike) ::: Mike has an F1 visa.
